verses.en: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Agradecei ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.en_bbe: O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
verses.pt: Digam isso os resgatados pelo SENHOR, os quais ele resgatou das mão do adversário.
verses.en_web: Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
verses.en_bbe: Let those whose cause the Lord has taken up say so, his people whom he has taken out of the hands of their haters;

verses.en: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
verses.pt: E os que ele ajuntou de todas as terras, do oriente e do ocidente, do norte e do sul.
verses.en_web: And gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
verses.en_bbe: Making them come together out of all the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

verses.en: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
verses.pt: Os que andaram sem rumo no deserto, por caminhos solitários; os que não acharam cidade para morarem.
verses.en_web: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
verses.en_bbe: They were wandering in the waste places; they saw no way to a resting-place.

verses.en: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
verses.pt: Famintos e sedentos, suas almas neles desfaleciam.
verses.en_web: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
verses.en_bbe: Their souls became feeble for need of food and drink.

verses.en: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
verses.pt: Mas eles clamaram ao SENHOR em suas angústias, e ele os livrou de suas aflições.
verses.en_web: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses,
verses.en_bbe: Then they sent up their cry to the Lord in their sorrow, and he gave them salvation out of all their troubles;

verses.en: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
verses.pt: E os levou ao caminho correto, para irem a uma cidade de moradia.
verses.en_web: he led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
verses.en_bbe: Guiding them in the right way, so that they might come into the town of their resting-place.

verses.en: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.pt: Agradeçam ao SENHOR por sua bondade, e suas maravilhas perante os filhos dos homens.
verses.en_web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
verses.en_bbe: Let men give praise to the Lord for his mercy, and for the wonders which he does for the children of men!

verses.en: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
verses.pt: Porque ele fartou a alma sedenta, e encheu de bem a alma faminta;
verses.en_web: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
verses.en_bbe: He gives its desire to the unresting soul, so that it is full of good things.

verses.en: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
verses.pt: Os que estavam sentados em trevas e sombra de morte, presos com aflição e ferro,
verses.en_web: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
verses.en_bbe: Those who were in the dark, in the black night, in chains of sorrow and iron;

verses.en: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:
verses.pt: Porque se rebelaram contra os mandamentos de Deus, e rejeitaram o conselho do Altíssimo.
verses.en_web: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.
verses.en_bbe: Because they went against the words of God, and gave no thought to the laws of the Most High:

verses.en: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
verses.pt: Por isso ele abateu seus corações com trabalhos cansativos; eles tropeçaram, e não houve quem os socorresse.
verses.en_web: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
verses.en_bbe: So that he made their hearts weighted down with grief; they were falling, and had no helper.

verses.en: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.pt: Porém eles clamaram ao SENHOR em suas angústias, e ele os livrou de suas aflições.
verses.en_web: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.en_bbe: Then they sent up their cry to the Lord in their sorrow, and he gave them salvation out of all their troubles.

verses.en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
verses.pt: Ele os tirou das trevas e da sombra da morte, e quebrou suas correntes de prisão.
verses.en_web: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
verses.en_bbe: He took them out of the dark and the black night, and all their chains were broken.

verses.en: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.pt: Agradeçam ao SENHOR pela sua bondade, e suas maravilhas perante os filhos dos homens.
verses.en_web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
verses.en_bbe: Let men give praise to the Lord for his mercy, and for the wonders which he does for the children of men!

verses.en: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
verses.pt: Porque ele quebrou as portas de bronze, e despedaçou os ferrolhos de ferro.
verses.en_web: For he has broken the gates of brass, and cut through bars of iron.
verses.en_bbe: The doors of brass are broken by his arm, and the bands of iron are cut in two.

verses.en: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
verses.pt: Os tolos foram afligidos por causa de seu caminho de transgressões e por suas perversidades.
verses.en_web: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.
verses.en_bbe: Foolish men, because of their sins, and because of their wrongdoing, are troubled;

verses.en: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
verses.pt: A alma deles perdeu o interesse por todo tipo de comida, e chegaram até às portas da morte.
verses.en_web: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
verses.en_bbe: They are disgusted by all food, and they come near to the doors of death.

verses.en: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.
verses.pt: Porém eles clamaram ao SENHOR em suas angústias, e ele os livrou de suas aflições.
verses.en_web: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, he saves them out of their distresses.
verses.en_bbe: Then they send up their cry to the Lord in their sorrow, and he gives them salvation out of all their troubles.

verses.en: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
verses.pt: Ele enviou sua palavra, e os sarou; e ele os livrou de suas covas.
verses.en_web: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
verses.en_bbe: He sent his word and made them well, and kept them safe from the underworld.

verses.en: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.pt: Agradeçam ao SENHOR por sua bondade, e suas maravilhas perante os filhos dos homens.
verses.en_web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
verses.en_bbe: Let men give praise to the Lord for his mercy, and for the wonders which he does for the children of men!

verses.en: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
verses.pt: E sacrifiquem sacrifícios de gratidão; e anunciai as obras dele com alegria.
verses.en_web: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
verses.en_bbe: Let them make offerings of praise, giving news of his works with cries of joy.

verses.en: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
verses.pt: Os que descem ao mar em navios, trabalhando em muitas águas,
verses.en_web: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters;
verses.en_bbe: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in the great waters;

verses.en: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.
verses.pt: Esses veem as obras do SENHOR, e suas maravilhas nas profundezas.
verses.en_web: These see Yahweh’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.
verses.en_bbe: They see the works of the Lord, and his wonders in the deep.

verses.en: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
verses.pt: Porque quando ele fala, ele faz levantar tormentas de vento, que levanta suas ondas.
verses.en_web: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
verses.en_bbe: For at his word comes up the storm-wind, lifting high the waves.

verses.en: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
verses.pt: Elas sobem aos céus, e descem aos abismos; a alma deles se derrete de angústia.
verses.en_web: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
verses.en_bbe: The sailors go up to heaven, and down into the deep; their souls are wasted because of their trouble.

verses.en: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit’s end.
verses.pt: Eles cambaleiam e vacilam como bêbados, e toda a sabedoria deles se acaba.
verses.en_web: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
verses.en_bbe: They are turned here and there, rolling like a man who is full of wine; and all their wisdom comes to nothing.

verses.en: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
verses.pt: Então eles clamaram ao SENHOR em suas angústias, e ele os tirou de suas aflições.
verses.en_web: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
verses.en_bbe: Then they send up their cry to the Lord in their sorrow, and he gives them salvation out of all their troubles.

verses.en: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
verses.pt: Ele fez cessar as tormentas, e as ondas se calaram.
verses.en_web: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
verses.en_bbe: He makes the storm into a calm, so that the waves are at peace.

verses.en: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
verses.pt: Então se alegraram, porque houve calmaria; e ele os levou ao porto que queriam chegar.
verses.en_web: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
verses.en_bbe: Then they are glad, because the sea is quiet, and he takes them to the harbour of their desire.

verses.en: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.pt: Agradeçam ao SENHOR por sua bondade, e suas maravilhas perante os filhos dos homens;
verses.en_web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!
verses.en_bbe: Let men give praise to the Lord for his mercy, and for the wonders which he does for the children of men!

verses.en: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
verses.pt: E exaltem a ele na assembleia do povo, e o glorifiquem na reunião dos anciãos.
verses.en_web: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
verses.en_bbe: Let them give glory to him in the meeting of the people, and praise among the chiefs.

verses.en: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
verses.pt: Ele torna os rios em deserto, e as saídas de águas em terra seca.
verses.en_web: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,
verses.en_bbe: He makes rivers into waste places, and springs of water into a dry land;

verses.en: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
verses.pt: A terra frutífera em salgada, pela maldade dos que nela habitam.
verses.en_web: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
verses.en_bbe: He makes a fertile country into a salt waste, because of the sins of those who are living there.

verses.en: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
verses.pt: Ele torna o deserto em lagoa, e a terra seca em nascentes de águas.
verses.en_web: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.
verses.en_bbe: He makes a waste land into a place of water, and a dry land into water-springs.

verses.en: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
verses.pt: E faz aos famintos habitarem ali; e eles edificam uma cidade para morarem;
verses.en_web: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
verses.en_bbe: And there he gives the poor a resting-place, so that they may make themselves a town;

verses.en: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
verses.pt: E semeiam campos, e plantam vinhas, que produzem fruto valioso.
verses.en_web: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.
verses.en_bbe: And put seed in the fields and make vine-gardens, to give them fruit.

verses.en: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
verses.pt: E ele os abençoa, e se multiplicam muito, e o gado dele não diminui.
verses.en_web: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
verses.en_bbe: He gives them his blessing so that they are increased greatly, and their cattle do not become less.

verses.en: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
verses.pt: Mas quando eles se diminuem e se abatem, por causa da opressão, mal e aflição;
verses.en_web: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
verses.en_bbe: And when they are made low, and crushed by trouble and sorrow,

verses.en: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
verses.pt: Ele derrama desprezo sobre os governantes, e os faz andar sem rumo pelos desertos, sem terem caminho.
verses.en_web: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
verses.en_bbe: He puts an end to the pride of kings, and sends them wandering in the waste lands where there is no way.

verses.en: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.
verses.pt: Mas ao necessitado, ele levanta da opressão a um alto retiro, e faz famílias como a rebanhos.
verses.en_web: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
verses.en_bbe: But he puts the poor man on high from his troubles, and gives him families like a flock.

verses.en: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
verses.pt: Os corretos, ao verem, ficam alegres, e todo perverso se calará.
verses.en_web: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
verses.en_bbe: The upright see it and are glad: the mouth of the sinner is stopped.

verses.en: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.
verses.pt: Quem é sábio, que preste atenção a estas coisas, e reflita nas bondades do SENHOR. Cântico e Salmo de Davi:
verses.en_web: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Let the wise give thought to these things, and see the mercies of the Lord.
